text: Hey, does anyone know if we have any official mentorship programs or something similar for career growth? Trying to figure out what’s available beyond just the usual trainings.

Yeah, we do! There’s a mentorship program—pretty sure it’s in the handbook under career development. You can sign up for a mentor or even be one if you want. There’s also stuff like coaching and some workshops, I think?
Oh nice, thanks Chloe. Is that the same as the Elevate thing or is that just for managers?

Elevate is more for manager training, but the mentorship and coaching are open to everyone. There’s also self-paced learning options—like O’Reilly and Linux Foundation courses. All the links should be on the handbook page if you want to check out the details.
